expected_level_description: You can: - set the organisation's contract management framework and standards - lead the management of strategic, high-risk contracts - resolve major disputes and decide on termination or re-procurement
You can: - set the organisation's supplier relationship strategy - lead executive relationships with strategic suppliers - lead the response when a critical supplier fails
You can: - set the organisation's standards for exit, transition, and data return - lead exits from strategic clinical and technology contracts
You can: - lead high-value, high-risk negotiations with strategic suppliers - coach others in negotiation and set the organisation's negotiation approach

You can: - advise on the lawful route for complex procurements and contract changes - manage the risk of challenge and handle standstill and debrief correctly - write procurement policy and guidance for the organisation
You can: - act as the escalation point and resolve large or high risk commercial management issues - coach others in appropriate commercial management

You can: - advocate for user needs, ensuring user value is balanced against cost and value for the organisation - determine the benefit of a product and persuade others it's the right product to use - write or contribute to business cases - communicate business-value propositions - help others make value-based decisions, influencing the direction of development
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it
